card.headline: *11 clubs* this season.
card.deck: Tadamon Hrajel withdrew before the start, so one club rests each round.

caption:
The new Lebanese basketball season has 11 clubs. 🏀
Tadamon Hrajel withdrew before the start, so one club rests each round.

الدوري اللبناني لكرة السلة هالموسم فيه 11 فريق 🏀
التضامن حراجل انسحب قبل الانطلاقة، وبكل مرحلة في فريق بيرتاح.

📸 MTV Lebanon
Source: elsport, Beirut 24, MTV Lebanon
@flb_official
#SportsWireLB #LebaneseBasketball
alt: News card over a photo from the season opener (a player in white dunking over NSA's number 15): Lebanese Basketball League 2026-27, 11 clubs this season. Tadamon Hrajel withdrew before the start, so one club rests each round. Opening game: Central 86-78 NSA.

facts.claim: The 2026-27 Lebanese men's basketball first division has 11 clubs (ليصبح عدد الفرق المشاركة 11 فريقاً; 11 فريقًا)

sources.outlet: elsport, relaying the FLBB's amended schedule (23 Oct)

facts.claim: Tadamon Hrajel withdrew from the competition before the season (انسحاب فريق التضامن حراجل), which is why the schedule was amended
With 11 clubs one team rests (has a bye) in each round (elsport: one team rests each round; with an odd number of clubs a round-robin round always leaves one club out)
Opening game, Sat 24 Oct 2026: Central 86-78 NSA

sources.outlet: MTV Lebanon ('فوز المركزية على NSA بنتيجة 86-78 في إفتتاح...')
